name: alakazam_ml_v28
model: The inherited LightGBM action ranker and bounded target ranker are unchanged. v28 changes deterministic end-turn exposure and metagame target-role values only.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, terminal wins, attack and KO routes, prize tiers, Boss use, support-pivot conversion, strategic evolution-line value, end-turn Active exposure, target-specific hand budget, board-count floor, matchup pressure, and Dudunsparce safety. The inherited target model remains bounded to +/-800 inside deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: Current top-team logs support explicit priority for repeated engines and matchup walls. Duraludon was absent from the latest 125-game sample, so its explicit role value is based on existing top-Alakazam target logs, the 27-game matchup sample, and its direct evolution into Archaludon ex with Energy acceleration.

v28_rule_changes: Score Teleport and Trading Places with the same end-turn Active-exposure ordering used to select the switch destination.
Use an end-turn switch attack only when the best Bench body is strictly safer to expose than the current Active Pokemon.
Keep Dunsparce Active instead of exposing Abra, Kadabra, or a ready Alakazam; allow Abra to Teleport into Dunsparce.
Add explicit metagame role values for Froslass, Munkidori, Fezandipiti ex, Dwebble, Crustle, Mega Kangaskhan ex, Duraludon, and Archaludon ex.
Rank Duraludon above same-prize Cinderace when both are reachable KOs, denying both the Archaludon ex evolution and its Energy-acceleration route.
Preserve terminal wins, higher-prize same-turn KOs, reachability, and protection-lock rules above metagame role values.
preserved_v27_invariants: v27 deck and both model artifacts
terminal Boss and Active win gates and prize dominance
support-pivot route and target-aware hand budget
board-count floor and Dudunsparce body-floor protection
post-resolution Dudunsparce deck accounting and low-deck exceptions
Mist Energy, Fezandipiti exposure, alternate-attacker, and protection-lock logic
known_limitations: The 89/200 v27 mirror result is below 50%; it is a warning against claiming aggregate local strength from this change, although the requested board-value behavior is confirmed directly.
The same-seed 100-game Grimmsnarl result is three wins below v27 and is too small to establish a meaningful difference.
Duraludon did not appear in the latest top-five 125-game sample; its priority is supported by older top-Alakazam public logs, matchup evidence, card mechanics, and a deterministic regression test.
The local arena and generic opponents do not reproduce leaderboard policy strength or fully deterministic native battle RNG.
Leaderboard promotion requires a real submission and per-matchup review; local validation alone is not sufficient.
